Definition: from G2570 and G4160; to do well, i.e. live virtuously:--well doing.
BiblicalUsage: Kalopoieo is to do well — to live virtuously, to keep doing good. Paul says to the Thessalonians, be not weary in well doing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that weariness in well doing is the commonest temptation of all, and the answer is not to stop but to keep going, because the harvest comes in its season.
